opening.argument: The video presents an easy front-running bot and then turns that demonstration into a request for viewer funding. It instructs viewers to use Remix and deploy the contract, then says the contract must be funded with BNB to snipe liquidity pools. The profit pitch scales with the deposit: “the more you put in, the larger the transaction. You'll be able to front run and the more profit you'll be able to make.” It further claims that 90% of profits return to the wallet and showcases 0.24 BNB in two or three minutes from a 0.5 BNB investment. Warnings that results are not always profitable and that fees or bad contracts may cause losses do not remove the solicitation to fund the claimed profit-generating bot.
